cards.text: The prophet Isaiah is carrying a message from the LORD to His people, Israel. The LORD calls Himself their Redeemer, the One who formed them from the womb. Then He starts reading off His résumé, and friend, it is LONG.

cards.question: First on the list: the LORD made all things. True or false: the LORD says He had help stretching out the heavens.

cards.text: Next, He foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners. Their predictions fall apart like a weather app promising sunshine while you're standing in a downpour.

cards.question: The LORD confounds the wise and turns their knowledge into ___.

cards.text: When His servant brings a message, the LORD confirms it. Then He says of Jerusalem, “She will be inhabited,” and He has a word for the ruined cities of Judah too.

cards.question: The LORD says the ruined cities of Judah will be ___.

cards.text: And the résumé keeps going. The LORD even tells the depths of the sea to be dry.

cards.question: The LORD tells the depths of the sea to be dry. Who does He say will dry up its currents?

cards.text: Heavens, earth, the sea, and then out of NOWHERE there's a name on the list: Cyrus, king of Persia (Ezra 1:1). I'd have read that line twice.

cards.question: The LORD says Cyrus will fulfill all that He desires. What does the LORD call Cyrus?
Along with Jerusalem being rebuilt, the LORD says of the temple, “Let its foundation be laid.”

cards.text: Now the LORD speaks straight to Cyrus and calls him His anointed. He says He has grasped Cyrus's right hand.

cards.question: The LORD has grasped Cyrus's right hand. What for?

answers.text: To bless the work of his hands
To lead him into the temple

cards.text: Kings get disarmed before Cyrus, and doors open so the gates won't be shut. But there's still a lot in the way: mountains, gates of bronze, bars of iron.

cards.question: Mountains, gates of bronze and bars of iron stand in Cyrus's way. Who goes ahead of him to deal with them?

cards.text: Then the LORD promises Cyrus the treasures of darkness and riches hidden in secret places. The best hidden treasure in my old junk drawer was a coupon that expired years ago.

cards.question: The LORD gives Cyrus these hidden riches so that Cyrus may ___ that He is the LORD, the God of Israel.

cards.text: The LORD calls Cyrus by NAME, and now He tells him why. A Persian king gets called by name by the God who stretched out the heavens, and I still answer to “hey, mustache.”

cards.question: The LORD calls Cyrus by name for the sake of Jacob His servant and ___ His chosen one.
Cyrus already knew the LORD when the LORD gave him a title of honor.

cards.text: The LORD says it plain: “I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me.” He'll equip Cyrus for battle though Cyrus has not known Him, like getting promoted by a boss you've never even MET.

cards.question: The LORD equips Cyrus for battle. What's the bigger reason?

answers.text: So all may know there is none but Him
So Cyrus will rule the whole earth
So Persia will be feared forever

cards.text: Next, the LORD says He forms the light and creates the darkness. Friend, I can't even find the light switch in a hotel room.

cards.question: The LORD forms light and creates darkness. What else does He say He brings and creates?

cards.text: “I, the LORD, do all these things.” Then He calls the heavens to drip down from above and the skies to pour down righteousness.

cards.question: The skies pour down righteousness. True or false: the LORD tells the earth to stay shut.

cards.text: Then comes a warning: woe to the one who quarrels with his Maker. Friend, I once watched a man yell at a parking meter, and even HE had better odds.

cards.question: In the LORD's warning, the one who quarrels with his Maker is pictured as what?

cards.text: “Does the clay ask the potter, ‘What are you making?’” Picture cookie dough looking up mid-press asking ME that, when friend, I AM the stamp.

cards.question: The LORD gives a second warning: woe to the one who says to his father, “What have you begotten?”

cards.text: Then the LORD, the Holy One of Israel and its Maker, asks whether anyone will question Him about His sons, or instruct Him in the work of His hands. That's the new hire walking in on day one to show the CEO how the company works.

cards.question: The LORD says He made the earth and created man upon it.

cards.text: His hands stretched out the heavens, and He ordained all their host. Meanwhile, I stamp one cookie perfectly straight and I want a PARADE.

Then the LORD comes back to Cyrus: He'll raise him up in righteousness and make all his ways straight, and Cyrus will rebuild His city and set His exiles FREE. Friend, I waited in a junk drawer for YEARS to hear somebody say that last word.

cards.question: Cyrus will rebuild the LORD's city and set His exiles free. What does the LORD say about Cyrus being paid?

answers.text: It isn't for payment or reward
It's for a share of the temple gold
It's for the land of Judah
